name: native-document-first-rendering-remediation
objective: Remove post-render repair architecture and make the approved Library First / Theologian experience native to the production rendering path.
outcomes: final learner-facing structure is owned by the delivered route/document and route modules
Theologian is a single direct cloud-plus-deterministic implementation
no MutationObserver or post-render renaming/replacement layer is needed
flat library design is owned by normal feature styles
offline, learner state, assessment, Bible, Topics, Practice, account/sync, feedback and theology behavior remain intact
invariants: 6 courses / 44 units / 117 lessons / 119 mastery-capstone / 236 scored activities / 45 topics
stable pre-existing activity and mastery IDs
Home Course Bible Topics Practice remain primary destinations
Statement of Faith remains doctrinal ceiling
questions-first spiral remains current curriculum model
local-first learner state and offline behavior remain first-class
no v5 bridge architecture, DOM repair layer, stacked runtime, or whole-body MutationObserver

nodes.label: Audit current main, active PRs, rendering layers, and commit plan/PEG
acceptance: plan and typed PEG exist before runtime mutation

nodes.label: Replace cloud Theologian observer/renaming upgrade with direct event-driven integration
acceptance: cloud and deterministic fallback both work

nodes.label: Move approved Library First Home into canonical Home rendering path and remove post-render replacement
Move Course/Bible/Topics/Study Focus behaviors out of generic DOM repair layer into owning route modules
Consolidate approved flat baseline into owning CSS and remove corrective override layers
acceptance: no decorative gradients in default baseline

nodes.label: Delete obsolete runtime/assets and update shell/service-worker manifests
Update validators and authoritative docs to encode native-rendering invariant
acceptance: validators forbid MutationObserver repair and stale Guide naming

nodes.label: Run automated release validation and inspect failures
Merge, deploy, and live-smoke primary routes and Theologian

risks.mitigation: preserve SW data strategy, update only live assets, bump cache release and validate offline shell
do not alter state schemas or stable IDs; reuse existing state modules
move approved rules before simplifying; verify rendered composition
retain deterministic evidence fallback and stateless request path
keep unrelated llms corpus PR separate until architecture branch validates, then rebase/absorb deliberately

rollback: Revert the native-rendering integration commit(s) to current main. Do not restore observer/repair architecture as the long-term rollback target.
